title: On the Computation of Values of Graphs
abstract: The paper discusses the computation of values of graphs, presenting mathematical models and computational methods to derive these values effectively.
summary: The paper "On the Computation of Values of Graphs" by G. Agnarsson, published in 1972, focuses on the mathematical modeling and computational methods used to compute values in graphs. The work contributes to the field of graph theory by proposing novel methods for calculating graph values. Despite the paper's potential implications for theoretical advancements in graph theory and combinatorics, there is little direct reference to its influence on subsequent research or industry applications in academic databases and web search results. This might suggest that while the paper contributes to the academic discussion, it may not have been widely cited or influential in further research or practical implementations.
